028/**
029 * Extended logger that provides convenience methods for logging formatted messages.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * This class extends {@link java.util.logging.Logger} and uses delegation internally to wrap
033 * an underlying {@link java.util.logging.Logger} instance. This design provides:
034 * </p>
035 * <ul>
036 *    <li>Type compatibility - extends RichLogger for use anywhere a RichLogger is expected
037 *    <li>Flexibility - can wrap existing logger instances
038 *    <li>Convenience methods for formatted logging using {@link org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts#fs(String, Object...)}
039 * </ul>
040 *
041 * <h5 class='section'>Features:</h5>
042 * <ul>
043 *    <li>All standard {@link java.util.logging.Logger} functionality via delegation
044 *    <li>Convenience methods for formatted logging at all log levels
045 *    <li>Lazy evaluation of formatted messages using {@link org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts#fs(String, Object...)}
046 *    <li>Printf-style formatting (rendered via {@link org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.StringUtils#format(String, Object...)})
047 * </ul>
048 *
049 * <h5 class='section'>Format Support:</h5>
050 * <p>
051 * The formatting methods use printf-style ({@link java.util.Formatter}) placeholders. MessageFormat-style
052 * (<js>"{0}"</js>) patterns are <b>not</b> expanded here — use {@link org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts#mf(String, Object...)} /
053 * {@link org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.StringUtils#mformat(String, Object...)} for those:
054 * </p>
055 * <ul>
056 *    <li><b>Printf-style:</b> <js>"%s"</js>, <js>"%d"</js>, <js>"%1$s"</js>, etc.
057 * </ul>
058 *
059 * <p>
060 * Juneau {@link RichLogger} patterns are printf-style. Because {@link LogRecord#getMessage()} returns the
061 * already-substituted message, the {@link java.text.MessageFormat} parameter contract of the underlying
062 * {@link java.util.logging.LogRecord} only surfaces if a record is serialized and consumed as a plain
063 * {@link java.util.logging.LogRecord} by a non-Juneau handler.
064 * </p>
065 *
066 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
067 * <p class='bjava'>
068 *    RichLogger <jv>logger</jv> = RichLogger.getLogger(MyClass.<jk>class</jk>.getName());
069 *
070 *    <jc>// Formatted logging at different levels (printf-style placeholders)</jc>
071 *    <jv>logger</jv>.severe(<js>"Error processing user %s: %s"</js>, userId, error);
072 *    <jv>logger</jv>.warning(<js>"Failed to connect to %s after %d attempts"</js>, hostname, attempts);
073 *    <jv>logger</jv>.info(<js>"Processing %s items"</js>, count);
074 *    <jv>logger</jv>.fine(<js>"Debug value: %s"</js>, debugValue);
075 * </p>
076 *
077 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
078 *    <li class='jc'>{@link org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts#fs(String, Object...)}
079 *    <li class='jc'>{@link org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.StringUtils#format(String, Object...)}
080 *    <li class='jc'>{@link java.util.logging.Logger}
081 * </ul>
082 */
083@SuppressWarnings({
084   "java:S100", // Method names match java.util.logging.Logger for API compatibility
085   "java:S1192", // String literals intentionally duplicated for clarity
086   "java:S2176", // Class name intentionally matches java.util.logging.Logger; extends it to provide Juneau-specific logging enhancements
087   "resource" // Caller takes ownership of the returned LogRecordCapture
088})
089public class RichLogger extends java.util.logging.Logger {
090
091   /**
092    * Permanent registry of logger instances by name.
093    *
094    * <p>
095    * Uses an unbounded {@link ConcurrentHashMap} so every name maps to exactly one
096    * {@link RichLogger} instance for the JVM lifetime.  An evictable cache (e.g. one with a
097    * {@code maxSize} that clears the whole map) would cause a class-loaded
098    * {@code static final RichLogger} field to refer to an instance that is no longer in the
099    * registry; a subsequent call to {@link #getLogger(String)} would then return a new,
100    * different instance, breaking {@link LogRecordCapture} and any other code that
101    * assumes one name == one identity.
102    */
103   private static final ConcurrentHashMap<String,LoggerRef> loggers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
104   private static final ReferenceQueue<RichLogger> loggerQueue = new ReferenceQueue<>();
105
106   private static final class LoggerRef extends WeakReference<RichLogger> {
107      final String name;
108
109      LoggerRef(String name, RichLogger referent, ReferenceQueue<RichLogger> q) {
110         super(referent, q);
111         this.name = name;
112      }
113   }
114
115   /**
116    * The underlying logger instance that we delegate to.
117    */
118   private final java.util.logging.Logger delegate;
119
120   private final MessageGenerator generator;
121   private final RichLogger canonical;
122
123   /**
124    * List of log record listeners.
125    */
126   private final List<LogRecordListener> listeners;
127   private volatile boolean useParentListeners = true;
128
129   /**
130    * Protected constructor - wraps an existing logger instance.
131    *
132    * @param delegate The underlying logger to delegate to.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
133    */
134   protected RichLogger(java.util.logging.Logger delegate) {
135      this(delegate, MessageGenerator.PRINTF, null);
136   }
137
138   private RichLogger(java.util.logging.Logger delegate, MessageGenerator generator, RichLogger canonical) {
139      super(delegate.getName(), null);
140      this.delegate = delegate;
141      this.generator = generator == null ? MessageGenerator.PRINTF : generator;
142      this.canonical = canonical == null ? this : canonical;
143      this.listeners = canonical == null ? Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>()) : null;
144   }
145
146   /**
147    * Creates a logger for the specified name.
148    *
149    * <p>
150    * This method returns the same RichLogger instance for a given name, ensuring that
151    * listeners attached to a logger persist across multiple calls to {@link #getLogger(String)}.
152    * RichLogger instances are cached and automatically created using the underlying
153    * {@link java.util.logging.Logger#getLogger(String)}.
154    *
155    * @param name The logger name.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
156    * @return A logger instance (cached and reused for the same name).
157    */
158   @SuppressWarnings({
159      "java:S9149" // Intentional factory override of the hidden static Logger.getLogger(String); public API callers depend on this name/signature.
160   })
161   public static RichLogger getLogger(String name) {
162      drainCollectedLoggers();
163      while (true) {
164         var currentRef = loggers.get(name);
165         var current = currentRef == null ? null : currentRef.get();
166         if (current != null)
167            return current;
168         var created = new RichLogger(java.util.logging.Logger.getLogger(name));
169         var createdRef = new LoggerRef(name, created, loggerQueue);
170         if (currentRef == null) {
171            if (loggers.putIfAbsent(name, createdRef) == null)
172               return created;
173         } else if (loggers.replace(name, currentRef, createdRef))
174            return created;
175         drainCollectedLoggers();
176      }
177   }
178
179   /**
180    * Creates a logger for the specified class.
181    *
182    * @param clazz The class.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
183    * @return A logger instance.
184    */
185   public static RichLogger getLogger(Class<?> clazz) {
186      return getLogger(cn(clazz));
187   }
188
189   /**
190    * Returns the thread-confined {@link LogContext} whose entries are auto-attached to every {@link LogRecord} emitted
191    * on the current thread while a scope is open.
192    *
193    * <p>
194    * Repeated calls return the same singleton (there is exactly one thread-local context map; sharing is harmless).
195    *
196    * @return The shared {@link LogContext} singleton.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
197    */
198   public static LogContext context() {
199      return LogContext.INSTANCE;
200   }
201
202   static RichLogger findLogger(String name) {
203      drainCollectedLoggers();
204      var ref = loggers.get(name);
205      if (ref == null)
206         return null;
207      var logger = ref.get();
208      if (logger == null)
209         loggers.remove(name, ref);
210      return logger;
211   }
212
213   static void forEachLiveAncestor(String name, Consumer<RichLogger> action) {
214      var ancestorName = parentName(name);
215      while (ancestorName != null) {
216         var ancestor = findLogger(ancestorName);
217         if (ancestor != null)
218            action.accept(ancestor);
219         ancestorName = parentName(ancestorName);
220      }
221   }
222
223   private static String parentName(String name) {
224      if (name == null || name.isEmpty())
225         return null;
226      var i = name.lastIndexOf('.');
227      return i == -1 ? "" : name.substring(0, i);
228   }
229
230   private static void drainCollectedLoggers() {
231      LoggerRef ref;
232      while ((ref = (LoggerRef)loggerQueue.poll()) != null)
233         loggers.remove(ref.name, ref);
234   }
235

244   }

252   public static Builder builder(Class<?> clazz) {
253      return builder(cn(clazz));

256   /**
257    * Builder for creating configured {@link RichLogger} views.
258    */
259   public static class Builder {
260      private final String name;
261      private MessageGenerator generator = MessageGenerator.PRINTF;
262
263      Builder(String name) {
264         this.name = name;
265      }
266
267      public Builder printf() {
268         generator = MessageGenerator.PRINTF;
269         return this;
270      }
271
272      public Builder messageFormat() {
273         generator = MessageGenerator.MESSAGE_FORMAT;
274         return this;
275      }
276
277      public Builder generator(MessageGenerator value) {
278         generator = value == null ? MessageGenerator.PRINTF : value;
279         return this;
280      }
281
282      public RichLogger build() {
283         var canonical = getLogger(name);
284         return new RichLogger(canonical.delegate, generator, canonical);
285      }
286   }

296    */

319    * Removes a log record listener.

327   public void setUseParentListeners(boolean useParentListeners) {
328      canonical.useParentListeners = useParentListeners;
329   }
330
331   public boolean isUseParentListeners() {
332      return canonical.useParentListeners;
333   }
334
335   @Override
336   public void log(java.util.logging.LogRecord rec) {
337      LogRecordContext.attachIfAbsent(rec);
338      canonical.listeners.forEach(x -> x.onLogRecord(rec));
339      if (canonical.useParentListeners) {
340         var ancestors = new ArrayList<RichLogger>();
341         forEachLiveAncestor(canonical.getName(), ancestors::add);
342         for (var ancestor : ancestors) {
343            ancestor.listeners.forEach(x -> x.onLogRecord(rec));
344            if (!ancestor.useParentListeners)
345               break;
346         }
347      }
348      delegate.log(rec);
349   }
350
351   private static boolean hasAnyListenerInChain(RichLogger logger) {
352      if (!logger.listeners.isEmpty())
353         return true;
354      if (!logger.useParentListeners)
355         return false;
356      var ancestors = new ArrayList<RichLogger>();
357      forEachLiveAncestor(logger.getName(), ancestors::add);
358      for (var ancestor : ancestors) {
359         if (!ancestor.listeners.isEmpty())
360            return true;
361         if (!ancestor.useParentListeners)
362            break;
363      }
364      return false;
365   }
366
367   /**
368    * Central logging method that all logging calls feed through.
369    *
370    * <p>
371    * This method creates a {@link LogRecord}, notifies all listeners, and then delegates
372    * to the underlying logger.
373    *
374    * <p>
375    * The method will proceed even if the log level is not loggable if there are listeners
376    * attached, allowing listeners to capture all log records regardless of level.
377    *
378    * @param level The log level.
379    * @param msg The log message or format pattern.
380    * @param args The format arguments, or <jk>null</jk> if none.
381    * @param thrown The throwable, or <jk>null</jk> if none.
382    */
383   private void doLog(Level level, String msg, Object[] args, Throwable thrown) {
384      if (!isLoggable(level) && !hasAnyListenerInChain(canonical))
385         return;
386
387      // Create LogRecord with lazy formatting support
388      var rec = new LogRecord(getName(), level, msg, args, thrown, generator);
389      this.log(rec);
390   }
391
392   private void logSupplier(Level level, Supplier<String> msgSupplier, Throwable thrown) {
393      if (!isLoggable(level) && !hasAnyListenerInChain(canonical))
394         return;
395      var msg = msgSupplier == null ? null : msgSupplier.get();
396      var rec = new LogRecord(getName(), level, msg, null, thrown, generator);
397      this.log(rec);
398   }
